item.title: Niccolo Turini - Cutting Sound
item.description: Label: 4lux | Prix: 18,00 € | Style: House , Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: 4lux

Prix: 18,00 €

Style: House , Deep House

Some classically timeless, retro-futurist deep house warmth here, as Pisa producer Niccolo Turini makes his bow on Gert-Jan Bijl aka Gerd's long-running 4 Lux label. Rich in classic drum and synth-sounds, much of the material is propulsive and energetic enough for peak-time floors, but thanks to its atmospheric sonics and huggable motifs could also be played in warm-up or after-hours sets. Highlights include Mr Fingers-influenced early morning deep house jazziness of 'Let The Music Bring You Up', the chunky and wide-eyed 'Take Me To The Moon', the weighty deep-and-jacking headiness of 'People From My Loves' and the simply gorgeous 'Get Down'

item.title: Rick Wade - Players Theme [repress]
item.description: Label: Robsoul | Prix: 13,00 € | Style: Classic House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Robsoul

Prix: 13,00 €

Style: Classic House

Following the recent dip into the Theo Parrish archives that was The Twin Cities, Phil Weeks' Robsoul imprint looks to another one of Detroit's adopted sons in the form of Rick Wade. Like that recent Parrish reissue, Weeks re-releases another three tracks from Wade's bulging discography. The upbeat disco loops of "Players Theme" was originally released on French label Funky Chocolate in 2002 and still sound fresher than anything being plied by the Soundcloud dwellers today, while "Can't You See" from 2003 provides a more soulful take on house music. On the flip, the tracky funk and cascading string melodies of "I Feel Good" originally graced Wade's own Harmonie Park imprint in 1998, but sound no less vital today. Essential.

Tracklist:

  • A1.Players Theme
  • A2. Can't You See
  • B1.I Feel Good

item.title: Daniel Wang - Aphroasia Technubian (Remastered)
item.description: Label: Balihu | Prix: 18,00 € | Style: Disco , Nu Disco
item.content:encoded:
Label: Balihu

Prix: 18,00 €

Style: Disco , Nu Disco

Just over 30 years after it first started appearing in New York record stores, one of Daniel Wang's most beloved early EPs gets a remastered reissue. Created at a point when he was still learning his craft as a producer (he owned little more than a sampler and a couple of basic synths), the six tracks combined his deep-rooted love of disco culture with nods to the tactile deep house warmth of Pal Joey, the Burrell Brothers, and the organ-rich garage-house sounds of New Jersey dons the Basement Boys. Deep, sample-rich, tactile, melodious and evocative, some of its synth-heavy tracks sound like blueprints for what became the nu-disco sound of fellow New York residents Metro Area. More than that, it remains a genuinely brilliant six-track missive that has undoubtedly stood the test of time.

item.title: Richard Wolfsdorf Aka Ricardo Villalobos - MDMA (reissue)
item.description: Label: Sei Es Drum | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: Minimal , Minimal Techno
item.content:encoded:
Label: Sei Es Drum

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: Minimal , Minimal Techno

In his early years in the 90s, the now iconic minimal man Ricardo Villalobos recorded as Richard Wolfsdorf, and one of the gems from that era is this. It is a heavily sought-after two-tracker that has been remastered for this reissue. 'MDMA' is the real highlight - a brain-frying blend of electric synth work, sine waves, buzzy tones and ever more pressurised drums that add up to peak time and trippy techno excellence. 'Bosch' is then a more stripped-back deep techno mind melter with wonky pads and taught drums all working towards a climax that will still get floors going wild all these years on.

Tracklist:

  • A1.MDMA
  • B1. Bosh

item.title: Lars Bartkuhn - See The Light
item.description: Label: Rush Hour | Prix: 16,00 € | Style: House , Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Rush Hour

Prix: 16,00 €

Style: House , Deep House

Lars Bartkuhn returns to Dutch legends Rush Hour with a thrilling three-mix release showcasing his deep, intricate sound. Originally conceived as his final exploration into house music, the track pushes dancefloor boundaries with fresh structural ideas and interesting compositional twists. The Full Experience Mix is a near 13-minute odyssey of raw piano solos, deep chords, lush vocals and intricate percussion that all reveal Bartkuhn's emotional vulnerability and ability to express that in music. The Inner Experience dub hones in on mesmerising keys and synths while the Dub Reprise emphasises rhythmic drive with its chugging beats. This is house music reimagined.

Tracklist:

  • A1. See The Light (Full Experience)
  • B1. See The Light (Inner Experience)
  • B2. See The Light (dub reprise)
